title: Wristwatch with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- watch band top -->
  <rect x='38' y='4' width='24' height='30' rx='6' fill='#e05c3a'/>
  <rect x='42' y='4' width='16' height='30' rx='4' fill='#f07a5a'/>
  <!-- band holes top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='10' r='2' fill='#c04428'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='2' fill='#c04428'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='26' r='2' fill='#c04428'/>
  <!-- watch band bottom -->
  <rect x='38' y='66' width='24' height='30' rx='6' fill='#e05c3a'/>
  <rect x='42' y='66' width='16' height='30' rx='4' fill='#f07a5a'/>
  <!-- watch case -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='28' fill='#3a7bd5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='26' fill='#5a9bf5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='22' fill='#1a2a4a'/>
  <!-- watch face screen -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='20' fill='#0a1a2a'/>
  <!-- clock ticks -->
  <rect x='49' y='32' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#4af0c0'/>
  <rect x='49' y='64' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#4af0c0'/>
  <rect x='32' y='49' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#4af0c0'/>
  <rect x='64' y='49' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#4af0c0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='46' r='3' fill='#4af0c0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='46' r='3' fill='#4af0c0'/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='45' r='1' fill='#a0ffe0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='45' r='1' fill='#a0ffe0'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 53 Q50 61 58 53' stroke='#4af0c0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff8a7a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff8a7a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- crown button -->
  <rect x='76' y='46' width='5' height='8' rx='2' fill='#f0d050'/>
  <!-- band connector top -->
  <rect x='40' y='24' width='20' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b0b0c0'/>
  <!-- band connector bottom -->
  <rect x='40' y='71' width='20' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b0b0c0'/>
</svg>
